title: sdks: unify auth/retries, add streaming cancellation, ergonomics & version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Maya Patel
description: Unify auth retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, add streaming cancellation and backpressure handling, improve ergonomics for Go client, and bump SDK versions. This PR consolidates retry configuration (max_retries, backoff strategy) into a shared semantics across SDKs, exposes a unified StreamingClient.cancel() API across languages, tightens TypeScript streaming typings and helper utilities, and adds Go ergonomic wrappers for common call patterns. Includes E2E streaming tests, updated changelogs, migration notes, and release version bumps (Python v1.144.0, TypeScript v1.144.0, Go v0.50.0). Checklist: [x] Design doc referenced (ENG-3221) [x] Unit + integration tests [x] Migration doc updated [x] CI green before merge
